hooks.text: The undisputed largest star in the universe suddenly shrank in half.
How did the largest star in the universe suddenly shrink in half?
The world's largest star lost its crown by moving closer to Earth.
A star 1,700 times wider than our Sun suddenly lost its crown.

title: The Largest Star in the Universe Just Shrank
description: UY Scuti was long crowned the largest star known, but new space telescope measurements revealed its true size.

beats.text: The undisputed largest star in the universe suddenly shrank in half.
beats.visual: artist concept of the red supergiant star UY Scuti

beats.text: In 2012, astronomers measured the supergiant star UY Scuti at 1,708 times the radius of our Sun.
beats.visual: Very Large Telescope array under night sky in Chile
queries: Very Large Telescope Paranal night sky

beats.text: Placed at the center of our solar system, its surface would swallow the orbit of Jupiter.
beats.visual: diagram comparing UY Scuti to Jupiter's orbit
queries: UY Scuti size comparison Jupiter orbit diagram

beats.text: That massive size estimate depended entirely on an assumed distance of 9,500 light-years.
beats.visual: star chart showing the constellation Scutum

beats.text: But parallax data from the Gaia space telescope showed the star is actually 5,900 light-years away.
beats.visual: illustration of Gaia space telescope mapping Milky Way

beats.text: In 2023, scientists recalculated its radius down to roughly 909 solar radii.
beats.visual: diagram showing revised size of UY Scuti
queries: UY Scuti revised size comparison diagram

beats.text: While still a pulsating monster destined for a supernova, its cosmic crown was gone.
beats.visual: artist concept of a supergiant star expanding gas
queries: Red supergiant stellar wind ESO illustration

beats.text: A simple distance measurement proved even the biggest legend can vanish overnight.
beats.visual: widefield telescope image of UY Scuti in Scutum
